arabic text: AI CHAAND MUHARRAM KE TUN BADLI ME CHALAA JAA
english translation text: O MOON OF MUHARRAM, HIDE BEHIND THE CLOUDS

arabic text: AI CHAAND MUHARRAM KE TUN BADLI ME CHALAA JAA,\nTUJHE DEKH KE MARJAAYE NA BIMAAR HAI SUGHRAA\nIF
english translation text: O MOON OF MUHARRAM, HIDE BEHIND THE CLOUDS,

arabic text: GHAR ZEHRAA KE LUTNE KI KHABAR TUNE SUNAAYI TUJHE DEKH KE ROTI HAI MUHARRAM ME KHUDAAI CHOUDAASO BARAS BIITE SAB KARTE HAI SHIKWAA
english translation text: WE WILL MAKE KARBALA FLOURISH\nO GRANDFATHER (SAW),\nWE ARE LEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)

arabic text: MILNE KE LIYE BHAAI KO BECHAIN BADI HAI\nKAB SE ALI AKBAR KI YEH RAAHON ME KHADI HAI BICHDI HAI YEH MUDDAT SE ISSE TUN NA NAZAR AA
english translation text: WE WILL MAKE KARBALA FLOURISH\nO GRANDFATHER (SAW),\nWE ARE LEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)

arabic text: WIRAAN GHARON MEN NA ISSE NIND HAI AATI AKBAR KI JUDAAI HAI ISSE KHUN RULAATI QADMON KE NISHAAN DHAMPH KE BAITHI HAI SARERAA
english translation text: WE WILL MAKE KARBALA FLOURISH\nO GRANDFATHER (SAW),\nWE ARE LEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)

arabic text: GIN GIN KE JO SUGHRAA NE YEH DIN HAI GUZAARE ZINDAA HAI TO AKBAR KE WAADO KE SAHAARE\nDIN RAAT TADAPTI HAI ISSE AUR NA TADPAA
english translation text: WE WILL MAKE KARBALA FLOURISH\nO GRANDFATHER (SAW),\nWE ARE LEAVING YOUR CITY, PRAY FOR US O GRANDFATHER (SAW)
